battle.verdict: ElevenLabs is the clear champion for business presentations, offering superior voice quality and a generous free tier. Speechify remains a solid option for quick personal use.

narration.text: ElevenLabs offers 25 times more free characters!

First, voice quality. ElevenLabs delivers incredibly natural, emotive voices. You can even fine-tune speech styles. Speechify's voices are good, but they sound more robotic. For professional presentations, ElevenLabs wins convincingly!

Next, let's look at the free plan. ElevenLabs gives you a massive 10,000 characters per month. You can even create custom voices! Speechify's free plan is very limited, offering standard voices with a small daily cap. No contest here!

ElevenLabs is the clear champion for business presentations, offering superior voice quality and a generous free tier. Speechify remains a solid option for quick personal use. Which one would you pick?
